entities.name: Étienne Delessert
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Étienne Delessert was a Swiss self-taught graphic artist and illustrator. He is largely known for his animated series Yok-Yok and his collaboration with Eugène Ionesco, on Stories "1" and "2", as well as his work with child psychologist Jean Piaget.
